title: Outdoor places of assembly.
officialText:
The commissioner shall not issue a certificate of operation to an outdoor temporary or permanent place of assembly, including, but not limited to, tents, platforms, stages and outdoor assembly seating, unless the department determines that the space complies with the provisions of the code.

ARTICLE 118 CERTIFICATES OF OCCUPANCY
